week.text: Swaps cost no money difference this week.

list.name: The God of Soccer
list.desc: Averages 5+ goals per match

list.name: Ace
list.desc: Scored 8+ goals in a match at least twice

list.name: Metavision
list.desc: Scores 55%+ of their shots (30+ shots)

list.name: Predator Eye
list.desc: Puts 85%+ of shots on target (30+ shots)

list.name: First Striker
list.desc: Averages 10+ shots per match

list.name: Lawnmower
list.desc: 55%+ of their goals are grasscutters (15+ goals with a logged height)

list.name: Mid Bin Man
list.desc: 55%+ of their goals are mid bins (15+ goals with a logged height)

list.name: Top Bin God
list.desc: 55%+ of their goals are top bins (15+ goals with a logged height)

list.name: Maestro
list.desc: Averages 4+ key passes and assists per match

list.name: Playmaker
list.desc: Averages 4+ assists per match

list.name: Team Player
list.desc: Twice as many assists as goals, with 12+ assists

list.name: Perfect Passing
list.desc: 88%+ pass accuracy (60+ passes; wingers / CF: 30+)

list.name: Reliable Planet
list.desc: No errors leading to a shot or goal in 10+ matches

list.name: Unpredictable
list.desc: Averages 18+ dribbles and counters won per match, at 88%+ success (120+ tries)

list.name: Counter Dribbling
list.desc: Hits 70%+ of counters (10+ counters tried)

list.name: Lockdown Defense
list.desc: Averages 25+ steals per match

list.name: Iron Defense
list.desc: Lands 85%+ of tackles and defensive moves (40+ tries; tackles count half)

list.name: Analytical Metavision
list.desc: Averages 10+ interceptions per match

list.name: Iron Wall
list.desc: Averages 14+ ball wins per match (interceptions + half of steals)

list.name: Box-to-Box Monster
list.desc: Averages 4+ goals or assists AND 8+ ball wins per match (interceptions + half of steals)

list.name: Gambit
list.desc: Averages 12+ saves per match in goal (5+ matches in goal)

list.name: Bear Claw
list.desc: Holds 70%+ of their saves (28+ saves in goal)

list.name: Wild Instincts
list.desc: Saved 7+ shooting cutscenes or Awakening shots

list.name: Insane Reflexes
list.desc: Rushes out for 25% or less of the shots they face (3+ matches in goal)

list.name: Aggressive Goalkeeper
list.desc: Rushes out for 60%+ of the shots they face (3+ matches in goal)

list.name: Balanced Goalkeeper
list.desc: Rushes out for 26–59% of the shots they face (3+ matches in goal)

list.name: Impenetrable Wall
list.desc: Wins 80%+ of rush-outs (10+ rush-outs)

list.name: The Last Line of Defense
list.desc: Clean set in 40%+ of sets in goal (20+ sets in goal)

list.name: Underdog
list.desc: Averages an 8.5+ match rating against strong squads (factor ×1.10+, 5+ such matches)

list.name: Elite
list.desc: Averages an 8.8+ rating (10+ matches)

list.name: Consistent
list.desc: Rating stays within about 0.35 of their average (10+ matches)

list.name: Isagi Position
list.desc: Played 4+ positions, at least 2 matches in each

list.name: Flow State
list.desc: Averages 5+ Flow / Awakenings per match (10+ matches)

list.name: Seasoned Player
list.desc: Played 30+ matches

list.name: Superstar
list.desc: A New Gen averaging a 9.0+ rating (10+ matches)

list.name: Virtuoso
list.desc: A team Master averaging an 8.7+ rating (10+ matches)
